entry.label: Why will this go up in the next 1–4 months?
entry.help: One or two plain sentences. If you can't explain it simply, you may not understand it well enough yet.

entry.label: What would prove me wrong?
entry.help: A fact or price level that, if it happens, means the idea has failed. Decide it now, while calm.

entry.label: Is there a catalyst or event coming up?
entry.help: For example results, a product launch or a policy change that could move the price.

entry.label: Where did the idea come from?
entry.help: A screen, a news item, a tip. Over time the journal shows which sources work for you.

entry.label: Entry price
entry.help: The price per share you expect to pay.

entry.label: Stop-loss price
entry.help: If the price falls to this level you sell and accept the loss. The app suggests one from the stock's usual daily movement.

entry.label: Target price
entry.help: The price at which you plan to take profit.

entry.label: Exit if nothing happens in N weeks
entry.help: If the idea hasn't worked after this many weeks, exit and free the money.

entry.label: Risk % of capital
entry.help: If the stop-loss is hit, you lose this % of your capital on this one trade.

entry.label: I have read the last 3 months of announcements
entry.help: Company announcements can reveal problems (pledged shares, auditor changes) that prices don't show yet.

entry.label: I have checked the latest quarterly results
entry.help: Check that sales and profit are growing, not shrinking.

entry.label: How am I feeling?
entry.help: Be honest. The journal will show how your mood relates to your results.

exit.label: Exit price
exit.help: The price per share you sold at.

exit.label: Was my original thesis right?
exit.help: A trade can lose money even when the thesis was right, and win when it was wrong. Judge the thesis separately.
